t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ndemera Mungu wanjye, ko wandemeye kukumenya no kugusenga. Muli aka kanya, nemeye amagara make yanjye n'ubushobozi Bwawe, ubukene bwanjye n'ubukungu. Ntayind'Imana ibaho itali wowe, Umufasha mu byago, Ubaho kubwe wenyine.
